period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)'/'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited)' (distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' statements printed earlier in the same filing) — chosen per this project's stated preference for Solo over Consolidated wherever both are available. Note this is a DIFFERENT basis than this bank's own 2020 Q4/annual series, which is CONSOLIDATED (per that entry's own sources.json note that no standalone table was found for 2017-2020 because the FY2020 annual report itself is missing from the local archive) — do not compare this quarter's absolute levels directly against 2020_Q4.json without adjusting for the bKash/subsidiary consolidation effect; it does match the basis of the 2012-2016 and 2021-2025 solo series. Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to June 2020' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended April to June 2020' column (interest income 5,740,352,380; PAT 443,178,250; EPS 0.36) not recorded here. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly (348,378,350,302 + 39,404,646,783 = 387,782,997,085). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly.
